boundaries.system: mobile + MEC compute + MEC TX (frozen primary scope)

equations.cpu_energy: E_cpu = P_cpu(tier) * cpu_service_seconds  (== integral P dt; equals kappa*C*f^2 exactly when the allocation is physical)

evidence_class.helper_v2v_relay_energy: no accessible 2024-2026 primary source publishes a helper/V2V relay energy equation: the helper tier is a transparent assumption, not literature-pinned
evidence_class.kappa_helper: frozen config cites Liu et al. DCN 9(6) 2023 Table 1 - the source could NOT be re-verified in this session (publisher 403): treat as an unverified transplant pending a check
evidence_class.kappa_mec: same source, same caveat; implied dynamic power is 1 kW
evidence_class.kappa_ue: frozen config: chosen inside the verified band (kappa 1e-28..1e-26, f 0.2..2.5 GHz); corroborated by ST-HO p_local = 1 W at 1 GHz
evidence_class.rx_powers: NOT MODELLED (include_rx_energy=false); ST-HO Table 1 gives p_down = 0.2 W, so a RX sensitivity sweep is possible
evidence_class.tx_powers: frozen config cites Liu et al. DCN 2023 (unverified this session)

known_modelling_note: the frozen rate table (MEC 10 MiB/s, UE/helper 1 MiB/s) is NOT the physical rate implied by f and cycles_per_bit (4.1667 MiB/s at the MEC), so the ledger uses the DURATION form of the same allocation the scheduler executed and reports the work form and the ratio as provenance.

parameters.source: Liu et al., Digital Communications and Networks 9(6):1399-1410, 2023, Table 1 (F_j in [1,2] GHz, gamma_j = 5e-27); that paper's objective contains the service-vehicle compute energy (Eq. 15).
Liu et al., DCN 9(6), 2023, Table 1 (F_m = 10 GHz, gamma_m = 1e-27); frequency double-sourced with Zhao et al. arXiv:1807.02311 Table I.

chosen inside the verified band (kappa 1e-28..1e-26, f 0.2..2.5 GHz); kappa=1e-27 matches the Gu2025/Liang2024 vehicle tier. NOT imported from Liu2023, which is fully offloaded and has no UE-local tier.

unmodeled_components: receiver/static radio power (include_rx_energy=False in the frozen config)
MEC/RSU static (non-compute) power: server_static_power_w is null
battery state dynamics, charging efficiency and reserve accounting
warm-standby reservation energy (the reservation costs no joules in this model)
